use_case_summary: Primary: in-app support assistant (low-latency chat), secondary: document search + reranking for help center. Need embedding pipeline for semantic search with periodic reindexing. Rerank accuracy is business-critical (monetized workflows).
technical_requirements: Targets: chat latency SLO 95th <150ms; throughput target 100-150 qps for peak windows; embedding pipeline: bulk reindexing throughput 2000 docs/min; cost sensitivity medium-high. Must support SSO, audit logs, and KMS integration. Require per-tenant routing and optional EU residency for subset of customers.
migration_notes: Migration approach: 1) host compatibility adapter that translates VividAI-style requests to Redwood-hosted endpoints (keep same API surface for product teams), 2) run prompt parity suite (1k canonical prompts + 200 domain-specific templates) comparing top-k outputs, rerank order, and embedding cosine stability, 3) iterate on temperature/seeding and tokenization differences. POC will capture regression metrics (MRR, nDCG, precision@1) and automated diff tooling. Concerns: potential subtle output distribution shifts -> plan for automated rollback to VividAI during Dedicated rollout window. SE plan: create a 'prompt shim' layer to minimize authoring changes.
poc_acceptance_criteria:
- Rerank nDCG drop <= 3% vs baseline on curated testset
- Chat 95th pctl latency <150ms on Dedicated baseline at target load
- Embedding cosine similarity median >0.985 vs VividAI embeddings for canonical docs
- No security blockers (SOC2 doc + KMS integration plan approved)
pricing_notes: Initial pricing conversation: Redwood proposed tiered Dedicated blocks. Break-even target for Pecan Ridge is ~20% lower unit token cost vs current spend. Finance wants a 12 month committed plan; exploring 6-month ramp + 12-month commitment. Need formal quote by 2026-03-15.
